newsitem.title: INDIA: India bus crash kills 31, injures 20.
newsitem.headline: India bus crash kills 31, injures 20.

text.p: At least 31 people were killed and more than 20 injured in a bus accident on Tuesday in India's northern state of Jammu and Kashmir, the United News of India (UNI) said.
The accident happened 80 km (50 miles) from Jammu, the state's winter capital, the agency said.
UNI said all 31 bodies had been recovered.
The injured had been admitted to local hospitals in the area, it said. It gave no further details.
Communications in the region are often slow because the terrain is mountainous and roads at times unpassable.
Nearly 50,000 people die in road accidents every year in India.
